name: Empire: World War 3
author: Addicting Games
description: Dread it, run from it, the final battle will still come all the same. We thought world war one was the war to end all wars, and the world war two, but now at the dawn of a new millennium we are faced with a worldwide global conflict that will rue the fate of humanity evermore! Empire: World War 3 is a futuristic massive multiplayer online roleplaying game that puts you in command of your own sect of tech warriors and lets you build up your crew to possibly take over the world. You have the potential to upgrade your airforce, your armor divisions, and even your infantry into an absolutely unbeatable legion of unholy futuristic terror. If you have the will to grind your way up the ladder and know how to properly manage your resources than domination of the entire planet is within your grasp! Strike now while chaos reigns, this is the time to rise from the shadows of your fortified bunker and launch a crusade against the armies of man that will echo from here to Valhalla!
